snippet.title: Project Sentinel - Zero Tolerance | Announce Trailer - Cyberpunk Run-and-Gun with Arrests
snippet.description:
Wishlist Project Sentinel - Zero Tolerance on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4724380/Project_Sentinel__Zero_Tolerance/

Project Sentinel - Zero Tolerance is a pixel art cyberpunk run-and-gun platformer built around the Sentinel’s cybernetic roar, arrests, collateral control and advancing under fire. The Sentinel is built to take punishment, but survival depends on controlling the chaos around you. Break enemy morale, make arrests under pressure, rescue civilians caught in the crossfire and decide who gets taken alive or faces Zero Tolerance.

Updated Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Sey-2O3tuvA
WIP Gameplay Footage July 2026: https://youtu.be/iMiceMrPNtk
WIP Gameplay Footage May 2026: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=o7jO_BcW6lo

Website: https://projectsentinelgame.com
Press Kit: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VIz-a9fqfJLCOWUKMSLuel5CRgyBWvIp?

Follow Project Sentinel
